_what: Which side a bedframe's drawer is on, and any option a slip PHOTO states that the line's own text does not, where the customer's own text names no side. The catalogue holds Front Drawer (RM130), Left Drawer (RM160) and Right Drawer (RM160) and no neutral 'Side Drawer', so a side drawer MUST be recorded as left or right - and only the drawing, the supplier's own record, or a person can say which.
_why_this_file: Owner rulings and photo readings live in a file the moment they are made, never only in a chat transcript. See the memory note owner-answers-must-be-written-down.
_defect: parse-bedframe.mjs treated an unqualified DRAWER as a FRONT drawer and its side test required a space, so `Sidedrawer` (one word) fell through: 41 sales lines across 29 sales orders carried Front Drawer while the customer's text said a side one (docs/bugs/0824). The phrase MAP repeated the same mistake one stage later and was fixed separately (docs/bugs/0843).
_convention: THE SIDE IS READ AS YOU LOOK AT IT, not as the sleeper lies. Owner, 2026-09-12, confirmed on two documents: HC-SO-003432's hand-drawn slip (a stick figure lying head-up with the drawers drawn on the RIGHT of the picture) and HC-SO-003434's photo of the installed bed (drawers on the long side facing the camera, headboard at the far right) - both are RIGHT DRAWER. So: look at the slip as drawn, or at the photo as taken; a drawer on your right is Right Drawer. Reading it from the sleeper's own left/right would mirror every one of them, which is why this sentence exists. Same class as the sofa TV rule (sofa-handedness-is-mirrored).
_drawing_grammar: Every slip in this batch is the same plan view: a rectangle for the bed, `HB` written at the TOP edge, `TV` in a box BELOW the foot, a stick figure lying head-up inside. The drawers are a narrow strip drawn along one long edge, with one arrow per drawer pointing at it, sometimes with the count written beside them. Two consecutive orders in this batch (HC-SO-013070 and HC-SO-013071) are the same drawing mirrored - one bed's drawers left, the next bed's right - which is the owner's 「有一些是一左一右」.
_photo_source: R2 bucket houzs-erp, key so-items/<doc>/<line id>/ac-*.jpg. They are the AutoCount attachment thumbnails and are about 240px on the long edge; the pen drawings read clearly at 4x, the installed-bed photos read for orientation only.
